name: std::swap(std::thread)
intro: Overloads the std::swap algorithm for std::thread. Exchanges the state of lhs with that of rhs. Effectively calls lhs.swap(rhs).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 threads whose states to swap
